scope: Source inspection of production restart/stage geometry entry and measured single-rank t10 raw-face capacity; not distributed evolution validation

findings.finding: Rank zero reads the restart, other ranks initially own zero particles, and migrateTreeVorork4Particles redistributes before return. Fixture x-slab ownership must not be assumed to equal production ownership.
findings.required: Capture persistent ID and actual rank after migration; verify unique global ownership and preserved particle fields.

findings.finding: Each stage wraps coordinates then migrates particles. Ownership is stage-dependent.
findings.required: Refresh ownership and invalidate ghost records after migration; use synchronized step/attempt/phase/stage/rebuild metadata.

findings.finding: Shared geometry rejects multiple ranks before nearest-neighbor search and linked-list padding. Centroid and QBP caches are separately initialized. CUDA nearest-neighbor search is selected by the compile-time USE_CUDA path unless dynamic weights are active.
findings.required: A diagnostic entry must perform actual distributed padding and cell construction, export owned raw geometry, and terminate before unsupported force/HG evolution. Preserve ordinary solver MPI guards.

findings.finding: Capacity follows maximum locally owned persistent ID. Raw records above SHF_K=64 are silently skipped. This is a latent completeness hazard, not evidence for the observed t10 instability.
findings.required: Distributed storage must account for imported IDs and explicitly reject overflow; received geometry must be complete before reciprocal reads.

measured_capacity_check.conclusion: No cell reaches the storage limit in this exported pre-HG t10 geometry. This does not cover other stages, future times, or distributed padding.

next_gate: Same t10 snapshot, actual restart migration and distributed geometry construction at 1/2/4 ranks; compare ownership, raw reciprocal endpoints, volume, centroids and QBP data by persistent ID/image before any evolution.
remaining: Geometry-only distributed entry is not implemented. Full force exchange, ordered HG, collective rollback, CUDA canonical force and long-time physical accuracy remain unverified.
